content.short: SoQuest is a Web3 quest platform to earn crypto rewards from over 2,000 projects.
content.description: SoQuest offers a Quest platform for project teams to manage and distribute airdrops and rewards, helping programs achieve rapid growth. Users on the platform can learn, explore, and earn rewards while engaging in quests and promotions. By matching projects with suitable users through a transparent process, both sides gain value and opportunities for collaboration. As SoQuest collects on-chain and off-chain user behavior data, it plans to deploy a social data layer that can power more Web3 applications and expand the ecosystem.
